name: app-logs
description: Read and analyse a service's application logs on one environment from its Kibana/Elasticsearch backend, read-only: recent lines, errors grouped by message shape with counts and first/last seen, a summary of levels, pods, timeline and top errors, pods with their running image. Filters by pod, level, logger and message. Every environment can use a different backend and field mapping, all configured in ~/.dev-cli/.env.
